module.name: DOMAINTAINS
module.description: DOMAINTAINS activation and status module for FreePBX 16 and 17.
module.changelog: *0.4.1-dev* Security patch: validates SIP DNS names and IPv4/IPv6 addresses, rejects configuration-injection characters and malformed hosts, and brackets native IPv6 SIP addresses without changing provider identity hashes. Aborts provisioning responses above 1 MiB and bounds trunk, number and descriptive-field entitlements. Root DOMAINTAINS console commands permanently switch to the Asterisk account before module access; storage helpers refuse effective-root access without changing directory ownership or replacing signing keys. Adds malicious-input, resource-boundary, rejected-refresh state-preservation and privilege regression tests. Existing state formats, ownership verification, protected reconciliation, local Deactivate and Firewall behaviour remain unchanged. No BYOT integration or state migration is introduced. *0.4.0-dev* Architectural milestone replacing the hard-coded provisioning service with an administrator-configured, provider-neutral complete HTTPS endpoint, with no default or fallback. Adds a durable native-object ownership ledger, verified creation tracking, administrator-confirmed legacy adoption, fingerprint verification and interrupted-operation recovery, and ownership-protected internal teardown. Unowned objects are not mutated or deleted. Trunk normalisation preserves native identity and dial options, avoids native deletion side effects and verifies rollback. Removes automatic FreePBX Firewall management. Local Deactivate preserves signing identity, PBX configuration, endpoint settings and ownership state. Expands endpoint, ownership, adoption, teardown and recovery regression coverage. *0.3.5-dev* Adds explicit Deactivate and Reactivate activation lifecycle controls in the FreePBX GUI and fwconsole. Deactivate removes only retained activation authorization while preserving the PBX signing identity and existing managed configuration. Reactivate permits deliberate replacement of retained activation authorization while preserving the existing signing identity, requires valid retained activation state, and remains separate from normal Activate identity protection. Adds confirmation and CSRF safeguards, fail-closed handling for malformed or unsafe retained state, and lifecycle regression coverage. Secure activation storage now normalizes ownership to the Asterisk runtime account while retaining 0700 directory and 0600 file permissions, including atomic state and signing-key writes performed from root fwconsole operations, preventing CLI-created state from becoming unreadable by the FreePBX GUI. *0.3.4-dev* Adds the local PBX service identity to the signed activation claim in canonical token, public_key, timestamp, nonce, service order, validates the identity against ^my-[0-9]{8}$, and requires the provider response service identity to match the local PBX. Adds provider-authorised max_channels support with a strict JSON integer range of 1 through 500, applies the authorised limit to inbound and outbound DOMAINTAINS-managed trunks, repairs manual maxchans drift in place during refresh, and includes the limit in final local verification. Retained pre-entitlement state without max_channels fails closed as a local-state condition; no entitlement is invented and the stale state is not rewritten. Expands the README with administrator-first installation, ownership, refresh and security guidance, followed by provider-neutral developer guidance for implementing compatible provisioning, billing/order, carrier/number, DNS and SIP/SBC integrations without disclosing private production infrastructure. *0.3.3-dev* Retrying activation on an installation with retained state now performs a full provider refresh: after local signing-identity and activation-key checks, a freshly signed claim (new timestamp and nonce, same signing identity) is sent and the validated provider response becomes authoritative. Refreshed numbers and trunks are persisted as pending before FreePBX changes, then reconciled and verified end to end, providing self-repair for changed numbers and SIP endpoints. Remote failures leave the last known-good state untouched and make no local changes; local failures keep the refreshed state pending with a safe diagnostic for retry. *0.3.2-dev* Adds conservative role-based migration of legacy DOMAINTAINS-managed trunks and in-place provider-host reconciliation through FreePBX Core APIs. Preserves existing trunk IDs, valid managed names, and outbound route references; normalizes SIP authentication settings and rejects ambiguous upgrade mappings. New trunks retain host-derived hash names for compatibility pending stable provider-issued trunk identities. Full local verification and safe retry diagnostics remain enforced. *0.3.1-dev* Distinguishes remote activation failures from local reconciliation failures and preserves safe allowlisted local errors. Persists last_error and last_error_stage, exposes diagnostic status in the GUI and CLI, and clears persisted errors after a successful retry. *0.3.0* Adds provider-authorised telephone numbers and automatic exact-DID inbound routes to the DOMAINTAINS Test answering destination for audible inbound-call confirmation. Conflicting administrator inbound routes fail closed. PJSIP Authentication=None uses authentication=off, Registration=None remains registration=none, and SIP authentication credentials are explicitly blank. Existing DOMAINTAINS-managed trunks are normalized in place. Outbound routing remains restricted to outbound-role trunks, and provisioned=true is persisted only after complete local verification. *0.2.0* Adds secure service activation through the DOMAINTAINS GUI and fwconsole command, with persistent local activation status.
